value.rationale: This gives exact triangle incidence, rank of the common product, and all four simultaneous ranks in the commuting-idempotent graph of an infinite family of canonical transformation monoids. Pair commutation and maximal-family structure do not provide the short quartic or four-rank spectrum without substantial new enumeration; the result meaningfully refines a natural homomorphism/commuting-semiltattice problem.
